commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+3' 2 - 0 What a GOAL! A quick turnover allows Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) to mount a one-man counter attack and ends with him scoring with a precise shot from close in that easily beats the keeper. That makes it 2:0.
90+1' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Pascal Gross (Dortmund) takes it short.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Gregor Kobel is prepared to thwart his effort.
88' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a long ball in, but Gregor Kobel comfortably gathers the ball.
86' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
85' The substitution is prepared. Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Julian Brandt.
84' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
82' Niklas Sule (Dortmund) does well to meet the corner from Pascal Gross, but his close-range header is soft and goes miles wide of the right post.
82' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
81' Nuri Sahin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) replacing Emre Can.
81' Today's match ends for Marcel Sabitzer who will be replaced by Felix Nmecha (Dortmund).
79' Eintracht Frankfurt have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

77' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) for Hugo Ekitike.
76' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Fares Chaibi.
76' A substitution has been made. Mario Gotze is replaced by Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt).

76' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens sprays a wonderful pass out to Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Kevin Trapp problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just over the crossbar.
72' 1 - 0 Pascal Gross plays a neat ball into the path of Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund), who makes room for a shot and fires in off the crossbar! 1:0.
71' What a big chance! Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.

68' Corner kick. Pascal Gross (Dortmund) is ready to send the ball into the box.
67' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Dortmund get a corner.
65' High and wide! Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post.
63' Niklas Sule (Dortmund) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Kevin Trapp easily deals with the threat.

62' That's unlucky! Julian Brandt (Dortmund) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
60' Pascal Gross curls the ball into the box from the corner, but Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) makes a right mess of a close-range header when under pressure and sends it well wide of the right post.
60' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
59' Here is a change. Karim Adeyemi is going off and Nuri Sahin gives the last tactical orders to Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund).
59' Substitution. Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) replaces Donyell Malen.
58' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Dortmund force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

57' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Gregor Kobel leaps like a salmon to deny him.
57' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kevin Trapp intercepts the ball.

48' A lofted cross from Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
41' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Kevin Trapp has it covered and makes a comfortable save.

39' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time low shot towards goal from a promising distance, but Gregor Kobel denies him.

33' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) works the corner short.
32' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and Dortmund manage to earn a corner.

28' > collects a rebound after the corner kick and sends in a snap shot at goal, but it flies just over the bar.

18' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
17' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
14' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
13' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

13' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
11' The corner kick from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

11' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. They send men into the box.
11' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) gathers a rebound, beats his marker and goes for goal from distance, but one of his own teammates inadvertently blocks the effort.
10' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) took the corner.
9' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Eintracht Frankfurt win a corner.
8' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
6' The ball is cleared after Donyell Malen (Dortmund) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.

5' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
5' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) will deliver the corner kick.
